description: This source file implements a Metal (Apple GPU API) reduction operation (mean) for tensors, specifically optimized for Metal on iOS/macOS. It contains functions for creating reduction kernels, applying reduction along specified dimensions, and constructing the output tensor. It also registers the implementation with the PyTorch library.

methods.name: kernelForReducedDim
methods.description: Creates an MPSNNReduceUnary kernel for a specified dimension (3 for row, 2 for column, 1 for feature channels).

methods.name: wrapper_mean_dim
methods.description: Performs mean reduction along specified dimensions of the input tensor, utilizing Metal kernels on iOS 11.3+ and falling back otherwise.
